players.headline: Biggby Coffee 18U Defenseman Alvarado Signs NAHL Tender
players.name: Cameron Alvarado
players.excerpt: November 18, 2026 The NAPHL’s T1ER League is pleased to announce that Biggby Coffee 18U defenseman Cameron Alvarado has signed a NAHL tender agreement with the Aberdeen Wings for the 2027–28 season. Alvarado, 17, is in his first season with the Biggby Coffee program. players.excerpt: November 5, 2012 California Titans 16U forward Ethan Somoza became the first NAPHL player of the 2012-13 season to sign an NAHL tender as he inked an agreement with the Fairbanks Ice Dogs. Somoza, 16, leads all NAPHL players in scoring at the 16U level with 18 points in eight games played to date. The native of Simi Valley, California, also has 14 goals, which is tops in the entire NAPHL. Somoza was named the Poinstreak Peak Performer for the 16U Division back in the month of September for his tremendous performance at the season-opening event in Blaine, Minnesota. His California Titans 16U team sits atop of the NAPHL's Red Division with a 6-1-1 record.
